profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Sparrow Design
profile.summary:
Hey I'm Kyle Smith,
I encourage you to preview these webpages for more information about me:

Personal Webpage: https://yskkyle.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/KyleSmith0905

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Successfully delivered multiple web and mobile development projects on time and within budget. Releasing roughly an app every 2 months while managing bug-fixes on old apps and features on new apps.
- Directly contributed to a change that boosted our average position in Google search from 26 to 5.
- Significantly reduced code bloat by 75% in some areas while improving readability with reusable methods.
- Received written compliments from clients for exceptional work and quick turnaround times.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed tools, apps, and websites for professional clients. Worked with clients of different sizes, such as a successful Inc 500 company with $1M annual recurring revenue.
- Programmed a tool used to push 1000s of redirects between BigCommerce and Shopify.
- Automated the entry of product pages before AquaSupercenter's exponential launch.
- Modernized logos and websites for many local and global businesses.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Biggest achievements: Developed a highly interactive dashboard page, unified the site under reusable components, and connected backend to frontend.
- Mentored front-end team on best practices, resulting in improved team productivity and code quality.

honors.title: Math ACES
honors.description: Highest score on a math competition in Suncoast Polytechnical High School.
honors.issuer: Issued by State College of Florida, Manatee-Sarasota (SCF) · Apr 2021

projects.title: Shopify Parts Diagram
projects.description: Developed a parts diagram for a client using Shopify Liquid. The parts diagram allows the user to quickly add products to the cart. Behind the scenes, the parts diagram is a custom Shopify Liquid using custom styles (Also hint, you can add a style tag to custom liquid to prevent CSS byte limits).

projects.title: Roots App
projects.description:
A mobile app for making READ and WRITE connections with a local webserver. This app allows the user to customize a dashboard to see only the data they want. The user can write to the webserver. This app was built to be used in an educational environment at schools.

The app was built with Capacitor and Angular. Animations were built with Greensock and Angular CDK.
